shell.subtitle: Statistical process and manufacturing quality analysis

parts.title: Product part master
parts.subtitle: Manage production parts, specifications and customer information
parts.guideIntro: Use this module to register production parts. In SPC, sampling inspection data must be linked to a specific product part.
parts.guideNext: After creating a part, go to SPC control items to configure its upper and lower specification limits (USL/LSL).
parts.guideSearch: Enter a part number or name in the search box to filter the list.
parts.guideAdd: Choose Add part, enter the part number, name and required information, then save.
parts.guideEdit: Choose Edit part in the list to change the name, description or enabled status.
parts.guideSetup: After creating a part, use SPC control items to link its process, inspection characteristics and specification limits.
parts.search: Search part number, name, specification or customer...
parts.specificationPlaceholder: Enter product specifications or process requirements...
parts.required: Part number and part name are required.
parts.confirmDelete: Delete product part "{partNo} ({partName})"? This action cannot be undone.

characteristics.title: Quality characteristic master
characteristics.subtitle: Define variable and attribute inspection characteristics, measurement units and default SPC charts
characteristics.guideIntro: Build an inspection characteristic dictionary, such as length, weight and copper ion concentration.
characteristics.guideVariable: Characteristics measured as numeric values, such as length of 10.5 mm.
characteristics.guideAttribute: Characteristics expressed as nonconforming counts, proportions or defect counts.
characteristics.guideSearch: Enter a Chinese or English name to filter inspection characteristics.
characteristics.guideAdd: Choose Add characteristic and enter the Chinese and English names, data type and input mode.
characteristics.guideType: Choose Variable for continuous measurements, or Attribute for nonconforming counts, defect counts or proportions.
characteristics.required: The Chinese characteristic name is required.

processes.title: Process configuration
processes.subtitle: Manage processes and configure production machines by station
processes.guideFirst: 1. Select a process on the left, or add a process using the button above.
processes.guideSecondAfter: section, add or edit machines for this station.
processes.guideThird: 3. Maintain process, chemical and product control items in SPC control items. This master manages only processes and machines.
processes.search: Search Chinese or English process name...
processes.selectHelp: Select a station on the left to configure its production machines.
processes.noMachines: No machines are assigned. Choose Configure production machines to add one.
processes.descriptionExample: Enter process standards or a summary of work instructions...
processes.tankMatchHelp: Chemical imports match line/machine and tank, for example DP and its palladium removal tank.
processes.tankEmptyHelp: No tanks configured. Set up tanks for chemical machines before importing to ensure accurate matching.
processes.tankNameExample: Tank name, e.g. palladium removal tank
processes.required: The Chinese process name is required.
processes.machineRequired: Machine code and name are required.
processes.tankRequired: Tank name must not be blank.

traceability.title: Line and tank settings
traceability.subtitle: Configure chemical tanks for each line
traceability.guideIntro: Configure tanks within each line. SPC imports and chemical control items use the line-to-tank mapping to identify production locations.
traceability.guideNext: Create a process in the process master, then select it here to configure tanks.
traceability.sourceHelp: The left side uses the process master directly; do not recreate lines here.
traceability.addHelp: Select a process, then add tanks on the right. Codes are generated automatically.
traceability.orderHelp: Processes follow the process master order; tanks follow their configured display order.

groups.title: Control chart categories
groups.subtitle: Add, edit, delete and enable or disable control chart categories
groups.guideIntro: Configure top-level SPC categories, such as PROC process control, CHEM chemical control and PROD product control, to organize control charts.
groups.scopeHelp: Use the same code for control charts and trend charts belonging to the same business workflow.
groups.required: Category code, name and business scope code are required.

rules.title: SPC eight control rules
rules.subtitle: Western Electric rules 1–8 are fixed; parameters and enabled status can be adjusted
rules.guideIntro: Only Western Electric rules 1–8 are retained. Internal rule groups for charts or control items are hidden; a ninth rule cannot be added.
rules.search: Search rule code, name or library...
rules.nameExample: e.g. Two of three consecutive points beyond 2 Sigma
rules.required: Rule code and name are required.
rules.invalidJson: Custom parameter JSON is invalid. Check the syntax.

chartTypes.guideTitle: Module guide: control chart types and formulas
chartTypes.guideDescription: Configure SPC chart types such as Xbar-R and I-MR under their parent categories, including control limit calculations, sample sizes and formulas.
chartTypes.search: Search chart type codes or names...
chartTypes.nameExample: For example: mean and range chart
chartTypes.fixedRules: All control items use the eight WE rules. Chart-specific or item-specific rules are not supported.
chartTypes.emptyRules: No control rules are available. Add rules in rule maintenance first.
chartTypes.loadRulesFailed: Failed to load chart type rules: {error}
chartTypes.required: Parent category, chart code and name are required.
chartTypes.invalidJson: Formula configuration JSON is invalid. Check the syntax.

chemicalOverview.title: Line analysis overview
chemicalOverview.subtitle: Overview of configured CHEM control items. Enabled items are available for measurement entry.
chemicalOverview.reasonField: Reference document / reason (optional, up to 500 characters; applies to every changed item in this batch)
chemicalOverview.reasonExample: Reference document / reason, e.g. WI-CA-001, Rev.03, section 5.2, reason for change
chemicalOverview.reasonTooLong: Reference document / reason must not exceed 500 characters. Shorten the document name or explanation.
chemicalOverview.noChanges: No formula changes. Changing only the reason does not create a version.
chemicalOverview.partialFailure: Some chemical formulas could not be saved. Check the errors in the table.

fTable.title: Chemical F table
fTable.subtitle: Concentration formulas can reference cells such as F!B3. Calculations use the active version.
fTable.emptyHistory: No F table versions in this modification date range
fTable.firstVersion: No F table exists. Default values for the first version have been loaded.
fTable.confirmRestore: Restore {version}? This version will replace the active F table.
fTable.restored: Restored {version} and created a restore record.
fTable.applied: Applied {version} and rebuilt the formula reference index.

formulaHistory.title: Formula version history
formulaHistory.help: Shares version history with control item settings, newest version first. Restore versions in control item settings.
formulaHistory.empty: No formula versions in this modification date range. Past history is not reconstructed.

versionRange.help: Filter by modification date in Taipei time, including both full days. Either date may be omitted. Effective dates are unchanged.
versionRange.invalidRange: Start date must not be later than end date.
